duties.title: VIP Seating Verification
duties.description: Verify VIP seating plan before arrival.

duties.title: VIP Reception & Red Carpet Coordination
duties.description: Receive arriving VIP guests at the main porch, verify registration token, and usher to designated lounge.

duties.title: On-Site VIP Escort & Seating Verification
duties.description: Supervise escort team and ensure all reserved row seats are properly tagged and guarded.

duties.title: Guest & VIP Handling Department Oversight
duties.description: Overall leadership of Protocol department: guest reception, VIP movement, and ceremonial sequence alignment.

duties.title: Main Gate Security & Access Control
duties.description: Supervise gate security, metal detector checkpoints, and vehicle pass verification.

duties.title: Stage AV, Lighting & Technical Setup Check
duties.description: Perform sound check, mic batteries verification, projector calibration, and backup power switch testing.

duties.title: VIP Transport & Parking Allocation
duties.description: Ensure designated parking slots VIP-1 to VIP-20 are clear and usher VIP vehicles smoothly.

duties.title: Media & Information Desk Operations
duties.description: Manage press registration, issue media badges, and distribute event press kit packets.

duties.title: Online Poster Making
duties.description: Poster should be made as soon as possible.
